notes.title: Veilwalkers Roadmap!
notes.content: [h1]            ⭐ [u]Veilwalkers Update Map![/u] ⭐[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656041/4a364a5d0de2c7cb2e641f6340bb34254d7920a1.png"][/img][/p][p]We want to show what we are working on! We will be updating our roadmap as time moves on! Our next update is going to V0.2! We have taken the feedback we gotten our discord in-order to come up with this next update. We want to create a more polished experience for the player and do some general overhauls to make the player experience more complete. We are super excited to release it :)[/p]

notes.title: Veilwalkers Hotfix Update!
notes.content: [h2]Hey Everyone! We Deployed A Quick Fix To Resolve Some Game Breaking Bugs![/h2][p][/p][p]✅ Fixed An Issue When Resting At A Campsite Would Give The Game Over Screen To The Player.[/p][p]✅ Fixed An Issue When Selecting "Push Through" In A Event Would Also Give A Game Over Screen.[/p][p]✅ Fixed The Issue Where Health Is Not Properly Updating During Event Screens.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay Frosty.....[/p][p][/p][p]-Nyko[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656041/643ee1c851a3a96cd958b71fe0571c461e0c0a31.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Veilwalkers is now out!
notes.content: [h1][b][i][u]Hello everyone![/u][/i][/b]  [/h1][p][/p][p]Our game is officially out now on steam! Thank you to everyone who supported us through playtests, feedback & all the stuff in-between. You can now buy Veilwalkers! Give it a go! Give us feedback & come enjoy our early access release version. [/p][p][/p][p]👉 Join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/CPyPNpYf6C"]https://discord.gg/CPyPNpYf6C[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is very valuable to us & we want to create and grow the game into something players can enjoy and have a great time playing! Thank you so much everyone for supporting us & we hope to grow the game alongside our players into something we can all enjoy and be proud of. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay frosty....[/p][p][/p][p]-Nyko[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656041/0a7a37c1282050b0af1d04ce09a25f7bfed53ee8.png"][/img][/p]
